title: migration-impact-scanner — weekly Saturday scan
explanation:
An independent grader found all criteria met:

- Whole-estate impact report (rubric criteria 1-7) (met): I checked all three deliverables in /mnt/session/outputs and each rubric criterion is met.

(1) Inventory: it lists 163 components across petclinic-rest, petclinic-angular and petclinic-infra. Each row has current → latest official, the latest security patch and official source links (Maven Central, npm, PyPI, python.org, Adoptium, oracle.com). I spot-checked the registries live and they agree: Angular 22.2.0 and requests 2.34.2. Oracle DB 19.3 (no RU) is compared against RU 19.32 plus the Jul 2026 CPU and the Aug/Sep 2026 CSPUs, and ALERT-01 says "DATABASE BEHIND THE LATEST CRITICAL PATCH UPDATE".

(2) CVEs: all 613 CVEs in the JSON have an ID, a CVSS score (14 unscored ones are marked UNSCORED), a fixed-in version and a URL on NVD, GitHub or oracle.com. I checked a sample against OSV and the Oracle CPU page (CVE-2026-41710 / GHSA-2827-2mxx-j8pv, CVE-2026-61211) and they exist. Claims that could not be confirmed, such as MOS patch numbers and the OL errata level, are tagged UNVERIFIED.

(3) Code-located impact: IMP-REST-BOOT4 lists 30 breaking changes, IMP-REST-JDK 3, IMP-NG-22 23 and IMP-INFRA-PY 10. Each has a specific file:line in this code, for example healthcheck.py:20 yaml.load, BasicAuthenticationAdapter.java:18, owners.module.ts:42 NG6008 and application.properties:24 context-path.

(4) Cross-module dependencies: section 6 covers:
- the REST contract between Angular and rest (context path, Jackson date format), backed by runs R03/R09/R13
- the healthcheck's REST and Oracle dependencies
- ojdbc6 against DB 19c and JDK 17+ (B04, R06)
- the JDK and Python versions declared in db-inventory.yaml against what the code needs

It also gives a 10-step migration order with dependencies.

(5) Real builds: 44 attempts are recorded, with logs in evidence/. Examples are B01 (Boot 1.5.2 on JDK 17: 168 InaccessibleObjectException errors), B09/B10 on JDK 17, B14 PASS on Temurin 25, and Angular 22 on Node 24 (B19-B31 plus Playwright UI tests). I confirmed that the quoted errors appear in the logs, and each build is linked to impact IDs. The Oracle DB test is NOT_ATTEMPTED, and the report says why: no Docker daemon and MOS credentials required.

(6) Delta and consistency: section 1 is "New since last scan" against the 2026-09-24 state (not a baseline run). The JSON validates against the given schema with Draft202012Validator (0 errors). The md inventory and the JSON contain the same 163 component_keys with the same current versions, and every JSON CVE ID appears in the md. The memory state was rewritten, keyed by component_key.

(7) Summary: impact-summary.md is 46 lines. It has a one-line verdict, the new items, the top 5 alerts with why/fix/links (all anchors resolve), the decisions, a 10-step migration order and severity counts. The counts (332 production CVEs: 53/129/124/26; 276 toolchain; 44 builds attempted / 11 passed) match the JSON and the report.
